scope: Corollary 3.4 (CM transport of a Hodge class) of the manuscript “Milne's rationality conjecture for abelian varieties” (preprints/Milnes-rationality-conjecture-for-abelian-varieties-October-7-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 001 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 640701a0ea8d8026), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 17. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let A/Q be an abelian variety of positive dimension with good reduction at w, and let γ ∈ H2r(A(C), Q(r)) be a rational Hodge class, where 0 ≤ r ≤ dim A. There are a positive integer n, a CM abelian variety B/Q with good reduction at w, a rational Hodge class κ of codimension r on B, and a quasi-isogeny a : An 0 → B0 such that γ0 = (aj)∗ κ0, where j : A0 → An 0 is the first-factor inclusion. This is an equality of the usual absolute-Hodge specializations in every prime-to-p realization and in crystalline cohomology extended to Cw.
